name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (National Health Authority)

summary.oneLiner: Cashless hospital treatment up to ₹5 lakh a year for your family.
summary.whatIsIt: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY pays for hospital treatment so poor and vulnerable families don't have to worry about medical bills. If your family is on the official Ayushman beneficiary list, you hold an Antyodaya (AAY) ration card, or you are 70 years or older, you can get cashless treatment worth up to ₹5 lakh per family every year at listed hospitals.

benefits.text: Cashless treatment at listed government and private hospitals

whoCanApply: Your family is on the official Ayushman beneficiary list
You hold an Antyodaya (AAY) ration card

howToApply.title: Check your eligibility
howToApply.detail: Visit beneficiary.nha.gov.in or call the helpline to see if your family is listed.

howToApply.title: Get your Ayushman card
howToApply.detail: Visit a Common Service Centre or empanelled hospital with your Aadhaar to get your card made.

howToApply.title: Use it at a listed hospital
howToApply.detail: Show your Ayushman card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.

eligibility.label: Belongs to one of these groups

rules.label: You are aged 70 or above
rules.sourceQuote: All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, irrespective of income.

rules.label: Your family is on the official Ayushman beneficiary list
rules.sourceQuote: Families identified based on the deprivation and occupational criteria of the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 are eligible beneficiaries.

rules.label: You hold an Antyodaya (AAY) ration card
rules.sourceQuote: All Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) card holding households are automatically included as eligible beneficiaries.
